mapper.sql: a.*, c.name AS category_name, p.name AS period_name, k.name AS pit_name, k.pit_code AS pit_code, m.name AS material_name, h.name AS hall_name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_3d md WHERE md.artifact_id = a.id AND md.deleted = 0 AND md.status = 1) AS has_model

FROM artifact a LEFT JOIN artifact_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dynasty_period p ON p.id = a.period_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN excavation_pit k ON k.id = a.pit_id AND k.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = a.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exhibition_hall h ON h.id = a.hall_id AND h.deleted = 0
